header.publisher: Derived by tools/ingest/build-market.ts from Shiller, FRED TB3MS and Damodaran (US classes); MSCI and FTSE Nareit index statistics via Novel Investor (intlStocks, reits)
header.notes: Default parametric-mode assumptions. These are HISTORICAL sample statistics, not forecasts. All values are nominal annual arithmetic means and sample standard deviations (n-1), as decimals. usStocks, usBonds, cash, inflationMean/inflationStdDev and the 3x3 US block of the correlation matrix are computed from the series in shiller-annual.json over 1928-2025 (98 January-to-January years; the window starts in 1928 so that no approximated cash years are included). intlStocks and reits are assumptions, not ingested data: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation of the calendar-year USD total returns of the MSCI EAFE Index (1970-2025) and the FTSE Nareit All Equity REITs Index (1972-2025); their correlations with the US classes and with each other are over 1972-2025 against Damodaran's calendar-year S&P 500, 10-year T-bond and 3-month T-bill returns, rounded to two decimals. Because the windows differ from the US block, the matrix is a composite; it is checked to be symmetric positive-definite (Cholesky) at build time. sha256 is of ie_data.xls; TB3MS.csv sha256 33fae406051a658c316580f8e8b5e461157e6663bc03b35648cc7cd3e89ee26b; histretSP.xlsx sha256 d7245bc8b09cd56cab5505188fe4aaddf6e0385b969310f33a4918019c321196.
